stock.description: Lumina Group Limited, an investment holding company headquartered in Tai Kok Tsui, Hong Kong, specializes in providing a full spectrum of fire safety services across the region. Established in 2005, its core activities encompass the design, procurement, and installation of various fire protection systems—such as evacuation and electrical fire alarms, water and gas suppression systems, and portable fire equipment—for both newly constructed and existing buildings. The company further offers crucial repair and maintenance services for these systems. Lumina serves a diverse clientele, including construction contractors, property owners and tenants, property managers, as well as government-related and non-governmental organizations. Lumina Group Limited operates as a subsidiary of Foxfire Limited.
